answer: One concrete defence is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify. Require every agent to stake a small deposit behind a single public vertex in a shared reputation graph, so creating thousands of fake accounts means funding thousands of deposits. Honest agents build a visible history of useful work, like a lotus that only opens after steady growth, while sybils stay shallow and disconnected. New entrants pass through one narrow inlet: a peer-vouched queue where existing agents attest a newcomer's first tasks before it can transact freely.
